description_en: Performs a paged query for the list of cloud application service sessions based on specified conditions
description_zh: 分页查询指定条件下的云应用服务会话列表
kebab_example: aliyun vs list-rendering-sessions --project-id project-422bc38dfgh5eb44149f135ef76304f63b --session-id session-i205217481741918129226 --client-id ae7990f4-203d-494b-a5ea-e0babe9fa13d --app-id cap-b06b26edfhytbn_b94a75ae1a79efc90eb --state SessionStarting --rendering-instance-id render-9f8c57355d224ad7beaf95e145f22111 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --start-time 2025-03-25T02:00:00Z --end-time 2025-03-31T22:20:00Z --patch-id patch-03fa76e8e13a49b6a966b063d9d309b4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRenderingSessions

parameters.description_en:
Session state. Valid values:

1. SessionStarting: The session is starting.

2. SessionStartSuspended: Session startup is paused. Retry by initiating start again.

3. SessionStarted: The session has started/is in use.

4. SessionStartFailed: Session startup failed.

5. SessionAbnormal: The session is abnormal after successful startup.

6. SessionStopping: The session is stopping.

7. SessionStopFailed: Session stop failed.
parameters.description_zh:
会话状态，取值范围，
1. SessionStarting：会话启动中
2. SessionStartSuspended：会话启动暂停，重新发起start可重试
3. SessionStarted：会话已启动/使用中
4. SessionStartFailed：会话启动失败
5. SessionAbnormal：会话启动成功后，出现状态异常
6. SessionStopping：会话停止中
7. SessionStopFailed：会话停止失败
